cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Choose What Matters More
cards.instruction: Make someone choose between emotional safety and the outcome they claim to want.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. They're calling your audition number. Do you want the part enough to let them hear you?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I want it. I don't want them laughing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. I can walk you in or drive you home. Which want am I helping?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Walk me in, but promise they won't laugh.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can promise I'll stay. Is that enough to risk the audition, or are we going home?

mechanism: A corrects B's incompatible requests as an expert until B must choose between protection and the desired outcome.
confusable: Mere encouragement differs from making the safety-versus-goal choice explicit and refusing impossible guarantees.
comparison: An audition risks public ridicule; a lease conversation risks hearing an unwanted relationship answer.
seedUse: Keep the audition and lease pressures but make corrective distinctions do the work of forcing the choice.
